newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-SPURS SIGN TOP LEAGUE PICK.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-SPURS SIGN TOP LEAGUE PICK.

text.p: The San Antonio Spurs have signed forward-centre Tim Duncan, the top overall pick in the NBA draft.
Under the rookie salary scale, Duncan can receive a maximum of $10.239 million over three years.
Ten years after the Spurs selected David Robinson with the top overall pick, they grabbed Duncan to play alongside Robinson in the frontcourt, giving them a "Twin Towers" look.
The 6-foot-10 (1.77 metres) Duncan has been regarded as the best player in college the last three years.
He averaged 20.8 points, a nation-leading 14.7 rebounds and 3.29 blocks per game last season at Wake Forest and was the consensus college player of the year.
Duncan became the first player in Atlantic Coast Conference history to lead the league in scoring, rebounding, blocked shots and field goal percentage last year.
Duncan should be able to play either forward or centre alongside Robinson, who also has the ability to play both positions.
